messages:
Kevin (CS): Customer ThermoGen just pinged — they were invoiced twice for this billing period after attaching a PO late. Customer says both invoices paid by same card and PO ended up applied after renewal. They're asking for a refund and explanation :grimacing:
Josh (Support): Ugh. Do we have invoice IDs and txn IDs? Can you paste the payment provider IDs so Payments team can trace? :eyes:
Kevin (CS): Invoice IDs: INV-2026-0741 and INV-2026-0742. Payment TXNs: pay_3GX9aB and pay_3GX9aC. Customer supplied screenshot showing identical charge amounts.
Sana (Finance): I pulled INV-2026-0741 -> marked paid via pay_3GX9aB. INV-2026-0742 also marked paid via pay_3GX9aC. Both cleared. Looks like tax recalc created second invoice when PO attached post-renewal. Need to confirm webhook flow.
Ryan (Payments): Quick check: payments are separate tokens — same card but different tokenized charges. We'll need to issue refund for one. Which invoice should be voided? Looks like INV-2026-0742 was generated 3 min after the PO attach webhook.
Marta (Eng): Noted. I dug into the invoice generator logs. There's a replay protection gap when a PO attach triggers a sync -> tax service call -> invoice regen. If the initial renewal had already created invoice and succeeded, a late PO attach causes a second invoice creation instead of updating. Here's the relevant log fragment:
```
2026-04-03T09:12:10Z INFO renewal job started account=thermogen
2026-04-03T09:12:11Z INFO invoice created id=INV-2026-0741 amount=1250.00 tax=100.00
2026-04-03T09:15:02Z INFO po_attached webhook received po=PO-9981
2026-04-03T09:15:03Z INFO taxsvc recalc started account=thermogen
2026-04-03T09:15:04Z WARN invoice create attempted id=INV-2026-0742 conflict=none
```
Marta (Eng): The conflict check should've spotted INV-2026-0741 and updated it, but our idempotency key was based on renewal_job_id only — PO attach path doesn't supply that key, so invoice created again.
Josh (Support): Ok that's the root cause. For customer-facing action: refund the later charge and issue credit note. Then follow up with a fix rollout.
Sana (Finance): Agreed. I can process the refund once Payments confirms the preferred refund target. Also need to handle VAT adjustment if we void the second invoice.
Ryan (Payments): Will refund pay_3GX9aC (INV-2026-0742) now. Refund amount = 1350.00 (including tax). Initiating -> will paste refund ID.
billing-bot: Refund initiated refund_id=refund_8KX3 status=pending amount=1350.00 invoice=INV-2026-0742 :white_check_mark:
Ryan (Payments): Refund completed refund_id=refund_8KX3 status=success timestamp=2026-04-03T09:42:00Z. Customer should see reversal in 5-10 business days depending on bank.
Kevin (CS): Notifying customer that refund is issued and sharing refund ID. Also telling them we'll follow up once final reversal is visible.
Marta (Eng): For mitigation: creating a small patch to include invoice existence check on PO attach path and use renewal_job_id fallback. I'll schedule a canary and add an alert if invoice duplication rate > 0.05% over 1h.
Sana (Finance): I'll raise a manual credit note CN-2026-0109 for accounting reconciliation and attach to the customer record.
Josh (Support): SLA action items: (1) Refund confirmed (Ryan). (2) Credit note created (Sana). (3) Engineering patch + canary (Marta). (4) CS message + apology (Kevin). Assigning owners.
Kevin (CS): Customer replied: "Thanks, appreciate quick action. Please confirm VAT correction." I told them VAT will be adjusted via credit note and linked once posted.
Marta (Eng): Follow-up: patch merged to staging. Idempotency now checks for existing invoice by (account_id, billing_period_end) before creating new. Rolling out canary to 3% traffic.
Ryan (Payments): One more note — if a customer attaches PO after renewal, we should prefer adjusting existing invoice instead of creating a new one. I'll add a Payments playbook bullet to coordinate with Finance when PO arrives within 24h of renewal.
Josh (Support): Great. I'll close the thread once finance confirms credit note posted and we have monitored canary for 2 hours. :thumbsup:
Sana (Finance): Credit note posted CN-2026-0109 attached. Marking as resolved on accounting side.
billing-bot: Canary metric: invoice_dup_rate=0.001 (0.1%) sampled over 30m -> under threshold. Monitoring continues.
Josh (Support): Closing: refund issued, credit note posted, engineering fix rolling. Notifying customer thread closed. :lock:
